This is the Gaza Dispatch audio briefing for June 8, 2026.

Here are the key source-backed developments from today's edition.

1. Israel kills 14 people in attacks across Gaza. Israel killed at least 14 people in Gaza on Sunday in strikes across Khan Younis, Gaza City, and Deir el-Balah. This was reported by Al Jazeera.

2. Smoke rises in illegal Israeli settlement after Iranian missile attack. Smoke was seen in an illegal Israeli settlement in the occupied West Bank after Iran launched launched missiles. This was reported by Al Jazeera.

3. Mediators for Gaza 'ceasefire' focus on arms, governance. Participants describe the talks as highly sensitive since last October's ceasefire, which aims to break the deadlock in the deal's second phase. This was reported by The New Arab.

4. Dutch report documenting Israeli shootings of Gaza children wins European Press Prize. Journalists from Dutch newspaper verified 114 cases of children under 15 being struck by single bullets to head or chest, with medical experts saying pattern suggests deliberate targeting. This was reported by Anadolu Agency.

For the full source-backed dispatch, read the June 8, 2026 Gaza edition at dispatches.thebluefernco.com.
